data.long_meaning: The name मुकेश is recorded with the meaning “God of Death”. मुकेश is a Sanskrit name meaning “God of Death”. in_sanskrit.name: मुक्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: To set free from bondage, to liberate, to release, to absolve, to exonerate.

in_hindi.name: मुकेश
in_hindi.long_meaning: A name for a deity believed to grant release from bondage or suffering.

in_marathi.name: मुकेश
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Death
in_marathi.long_meaning: मुकेश हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। मुकेश is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'God of Death'. In Hindu mythology, Yama, the god of death, is often referred to as Mukesh, especially in the Jain tradition.

in_bengali.name: मुकेश
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Death
in_bengali.long_meaning: मुकेश একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। मुकेश is a name derived from Sanskrit, which means 'God of Death'. In Hindu mythology, Yama, the god of death, is often referred to as Mukesh, especially in the Jain tradition.
